record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: If G is a finitely presented infinite residually finite group with a descending finite-index normal chain (G_i) of trivial intersection, and F is any field, must the normalized first Betti numbers satisfy lim_{i→∞} (b_1(G_i; F)-1)/[G:G_i] = b_1^{(2)}(G) - b_0^{(2)}(G) = cost(G) - 1 = RG(G; (G_i))?

evidence.quote: Question 9.4 (Rank gradient, cost, first L2-Betti number, and approximation). Let G be a finitely presented infinite residually finite group. Let (Gi) be a descending chain of normal subgroups of finite index of G with intersection {1}. Let F be any field. Do we have lim i→∞ (b1(Gi; F) − 1)/[G : Gi] = b(2)1 (G) − b(2)0 (G) = cost(G) − 1 = RG(G; (Gi)i≥0)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finitely presented infinite residually finite group, and let $(G_i)_{i\geq 0}$ be a descending chain of finite-index normal subgroups of $G$ with $\bigcap_i G_i = \{1\}$. Let $F$ be an arbitrary field, and write $b_1(G_i;F) = \dim_F H_1(G_i;F)$ for the first Betti number with coefficients in $F$. Let $b_n^{(2)}(G)$ denote the $n$-th $L^2$-Betti number of $G$, let $\mathrm{cost}(G)$ denote the infimum cost of free probability-measure-preserving actions of $G$ (in the sense of Levitt–Gaboriau), and let
$$RG(G;(G_i)) = \lim_{i\to\infty} \frac{d(G_i)-1}{[G:G_i]}$$
be the rank gradient of $G$ along $(G_i)$, where $d(H)$ is the minimal number of generators of $H$. Determine whether
$$\lim_{i\to\infty} \frac{b_1(G_i;F)-1}{[G:G_i]} \;=\; b_1^{(2)}(G) - b_0^{(2)}(G) \;=\; \mathrm{cost}(G) - 1 \;=\; RG(G;(G_i))$$
holds for every such $G$, every such chain $(G_i)$, and every field $F$.
artifact.category_tag: L^2-Betti numbers, cost, and rank gradient
artifact.status_search_result: The chain of equalities encompasses several well-known open problems: Gaboriau's question on whether cost equals first $L^2$-Betti number plus one, the Abert–Nikolov conjecture relating rank gradient to cost, and Lück approximation for first Betti numbers over arbitrary fields. Each of these is widely cited as open in current surveys on $L^2$-invariants.

status_evidence.title: L2-Betti numbers in group theory (Löh, lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of cost, rank gradient and the first L2-Betti number, with the equality cost(G) = b_1^{(2)}(G)+1 stated as an open conjecture of Gaboriau.
status_evidence.claim: Gaboriau's cost vs first L2-Betti number question is open.

status_evidence.title: Cost of equivalence relations and groups (Gaboriau)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes inequality b_1^{(2)} ≤ cost − 1 and poses equality as open question.
status_evidence.claim: Equality between cost and first L2-Betti number plus one remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Uniform non-amenability, cost, and the first ℓ2-Betti number
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Abert–Nikolov rank gradient and its conjectured equality with cost minus one.
status_evidence.claim: The Abert–Nikolov rank gradient/cost conjecture is open.
